q1_issues.issue: "started as a trickle" is rendered as a bare untensed property, so the parse asserts the movement is a trickle and is a gusher simultaneously, with nothing tying the trickle state to the start event or to past time.

q2_gaps: predicative "as"-NP after a verb ("started as a trickle") - neither the depictive rule nor the preposition-named oblique is named as its encoding
figurative/metaphorical predication (a movement being a "trickle" / a "gusher") - no metaphor policy, so the literal templates emit kind-memberships that are false on the literal reading
notes: The "turned into a gusher" half follows the change-of-kind template exactly (subject as Patient, reified state with Experiencer, flat copular atom, Result, no spatial Goal). The compound kind freedom_movement carries its genus with the noun modifier correctly left unexposed.
